subject: expression: add more optional properties for `EvalContext` (#51725)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent focusing on executor/expression. Change is a refactor to move DDL-owner + advisory-lock ops (and some session-var reads) behind EvalContext optional property providers/readers, plus adding a required `GetDivPrecisionIncrement()` accessor used by decimal division (AVG and /). Session-backed EvalContext (`ExprCtxExtendedImpl`) wires all optional providers and asserts the set is full, and updated builtins consistently fetch props with error propagation. No plausible remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics/session/privilege/concurrency issues found in the touched executor/expression behavior.
